list.q: Does SMP treatment reduce hair growth?
list.a: No. Pigment is applied superficially and does not affect hair follicles.
No – if done correctly, only you know it was done. The effect is natural and unnoticeable.

list.q: How long does SMP effect last in women?
list.a: 2 to 4 years, after which a single refresh session is possible.

list.q: What if hair thins further later?
